# EML Attachment Remover 2.0.0

Version 2.0.0 is an intentional clean break: every successful transformation now
produces a verified text-only EML working copy. There is no v1 compatibility mode
and no migration step; original messages remain unchanged.

## What changed

- The application selects one safe, resource-free `text/plain` representation.
- It atomically discards unselected HTML representations together with their
  dependent inline resources, then removes ordinary attachments elsewhere.
- It fails closed without publishing output when it cannot prove a safe text-only
  result.
- Default output names now end in `.text-only.eml`.
- JSON reports use schema version 2 and distinguish the selected body, discarded
  body representations and resources, and removed ordinary attachments.
- The macOS Finder Quick Action is now **Create Text-Only EML Copy**.

This structural approach handles messages whose editors encode user-visible uploads
as CID-referenced inline HTML resources. MIME provides no trustworthy flag that can
separate those images from legitimate signature assets one by one, so the application
selects the declared plain-text alternative and discards the complete unused HTML
dependency closure instead of relying on filenames, image recognition, sender rules,
or size heuristics.

## Downloads

- `remove-eml-attachments.pyz` — dependency-free CPython 3.14 zipapp
- `eml_attachment_remover-2.0.0-cp314-none-any.whl` — CPython 3.14 wheel
- `eml_attachment_remover-2.0.0.tar.gz` — source distribution
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for all three executable/package assets

CPython 3.14.x is required. The portable application is qualified on standard and
free-threaded CPython across Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows before publication.

## Verify the download

Download all four files into one directory, then run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
for asset in \
  remove-eml-attachments.pyz \
  eml_attachment_remover-2.0.0-cp314-none-any.whl \
  eml_attachment_remover-2.0.0.tar.gz \
  SHA256SUMS
do
  gh release verify-asset v2.0.0 "$asset" \
    --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
  gh attestation verify "$asset" \
    --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover \
    --signer-workflow resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/.github/workflows/release.yml \
    --source-ref refs/tags/v2.0.0
done
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```

The release workflow separately attests each checksummed artifact and the checksum
manifest. It also requires reproducible archive builds, isolated wheel and source
installation smokes, exact archive validation, 100% statement and branch coverage,
and a fresh 100% actionable mutation campaign before publication.

See the [README](https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/blob/v2.0.0/README.md)
for usage and the tested macOS Finder setup. The complete change history is in the
[changelog](https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/blob/v2.0.0/CHANGELOG.md).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/compare/v1.0.0...v2.0.0
